rules.route: One clearly supported customer-support intent. Assign one ontology label.
rules.clarify_or_abstain: Multiple explicit intents or insufficient information to distinguish intents; label __abstain__.
rules.abstain: Outside this store-support ontology; label __abstain__. Product specifications and compatibility, manuals and maintenance, stock availability, warranty repairs, and loyalty points are unsupported by the 27-intent ontology even though they concern the same store.

definitions.contact_customer_service: Ask for department contact details or general channels.
definitions.contact_human_agent: Ask for a live person to join/take over current interaction.
definitions.delivery_period: General expected time for a new purchase.
definitions.set_up_shipping_address: Add or set saved/default address for future purchases.
definitions.change_shipping_address: Change destination on an existing order.
definitions.track_refund: Follow status of an already requested/approved refund.
definitions.review: Write/edit a public rating or review.
